text:
henry_cs: Quick sync  small pilot spike: 5 orgs accepted into the preview but we only have 3 net seats left. Need schedule + renewal-signal checks. Tagging @rachel_ae and @nirav_prod.
rachel_ae: Who are the five? any procurement/legal notes?
henry_cs: List: ArborMed (confirmed), Skyforge (pending billing), Lumenix (confirmed), Packwell (pending legal), ByteWave (confirmed).
nirav_prod: Recommend 2 kickoff tracks: "business" 30m and "platform" 60m. Also add a renewal sentiment line to the prework: "How likely are you to adopt in prod after pilot? (0-10)"
kelly_ops: Ops will reserve the 3 seats now and a 48h hold for billing/legal. I'll add a PagerDuty rule to escalate if pre-kickoff survey <50% at 48h.
pilotbot: ArborMed kickoff tentative: 2024-08-02 11:00 PDT. Confirm within 36h.
henry_cs: Outreach draft (short): "Hi <Name>  welcome to the CUSP preview. Pick a kickoff slot (Mon 8/2 11:00 PDT or Tue 8/3 14:00 PDT). Please complete a 4-question pre-kickoff survey: https://forms.redwood.example/cusp-mini. We'll provision seats after slot chosen. Thanks! -Henry"
rachel_ae: Suggest adding expected QPS and compliance checkbox to the survey, and a free-text for procurement blockers.
nirav_prod: I'll publish the two decks and a one-pager for AEs on renewal-playbooks. Add a fallback slide for customers with latency sensitivity.
kelly_ops: Action items: @rachel_ae finalize roster by EOD; @nirav_prod publish decks; @henry_cs send outreach once roster final. Ops will queue provisioning after confirmation.
henry_cs: Thanks all  will post roster update here. If anyone sees a high-risk account (procurement hang, survey no-show, low sentiment) flag it and we'll escalate to AE + product.
